What this is

A fake, zoomed-in acre over a satellite backdrop of Stanitsa Luhanska. Four potential landmines sit on lattice points taken from the user’s example coordinates. Visit order comes from the preexisting robot mission queue in dist/robot/next_mission.json: higher expected_find is more important (compared at the displayed 3 significant figures); earlier queue index breaks ties. The dog never occupies a mine cell — BFS stops on a 4-neighbour. Dark overlay marks woodland, built-up blocks, and the rail corridor (open fields and sandy tracks stay passable). The photo is scenery only — it is not a survey of that town.
